summary: With stageAlign: 'center' on a one-column game layout (768px), the title centred with the board but the session's notices (a puzzle's intro line, 'Push each crate onto a goal.') stayed at the 16px column gutter, so the page still had two left edges; the earlier check measured only the title. The opt-in now gives the notices the board's measure and centres them, and the check asserts the title's and the intro's left edges against the board.
